description: Put a quantity of one item into a named carton: a description, how many, and the per-unit weight in WHOLE GRAMS. Leave unit_grams out when it was not weighed and the carton gross comes back as a lower bound.

carton.description: The carton id, e.g. C01, or its exact label

description.description: The goods going in, e.g. Oak shelf 900mm

packing_list.description: The packing list id, e.g. PL-2026-0001, or the order reference when only one list carries it

quantity.description: How many units go into THIS carton. Split across cartons with one call each

sku.description: Stock code, upper-cased and stripped of spaces. Lines with a SKU are matched on it, lines without on their description

unit_grams.description: Weight of ONE unit in whole grams. Omit when not weighed; the carton is then a lower bound

name: pack_item
title: Pack goods into a carton
